label: Phase 2 — Interactive Code Generation (iter 1, cold)
summary: Cold codegen for chemical_detector from canonical inputs: 18 Java files, 2 controllers (GasAnalysisController, MovementController), shared turn/stop/resume events via SignalBus emissions matched by name to MovementEvent triggers.

issues.title: No Final mode in either controller
issues.detail: CD-GA-Beh6 says the gas-analysis subsystem 'concludes its search' after emitting stop. Per CLAUDE.md (theory-generated controller must not contain a Final state), the terminal transition instead enters a live 'Finished' mode that self-loops on gas events without re-analysing. Similarly the movement subsystem's Found mode self-loops on stop (CD-MV-Beh9 'stays halted').

issues.title: Finished self-loop captures the gas payload
issues.detail: The Finished self-loop re-captures the gas reading into gs (required so the typed gas trigger keeps its payload binding) but performs no analysis. CD-GA-Beh6 says 'processing no further readings'; readings are consumed-and-ignored, not refused.

issues.title: Chem enum values and the target chemical
issues.detail: CD-DM4 makes Chem opaque with equality only. Implemented as enum {chemA, chemB} with Sensor.target = chemA. Arbitrary; only equality is used.

issues.title: Sensor index-to-Angle mapping
issues.detail: CD-Fn3's angle(x) mapping is not specified. Implemented 0->Front, 1->Left, 2->Right, >=3->Back; empty reading returns Front (safe default per codegen rules).

issues.title: Constant values
issues.detail: All constants are configured-at-startup with unspecified values. Chose THR=1.0, LV=1.0, EVADE_TIME=1, STUCK_PERIOD=1, STUCK_DIST=1.0, OUT_PERIOD=1 to stay inside the FDR4 {0..1} type ranges.

issues.title: analysis() positive-intensity criterion
issues.detail: CD-Fn1 says noGas 'if no reading indicates the target chemical'. Implemented as: gasD iff some sample has c == target AND i > 0.0.

issues.title: changeDirection extracted as event, not operation
issues.detail: Single-arg vehicle calls become RoboChart Communications under the M2M conventions (only multi-arg calls become LOperations Calls). CD-OP4's changeDirection(l) therefore appears as a typed output event in the model; its steering semantics live in Vehicle.changeDirection.

issues.title: Autonomous modes use total guard cover
issues.detail: Analysis (sts==noGas / sts==gasD over the two-valued Status enum), GasDetected (insAtOrAboveThr / !insAtOrAboveThr) and AvoidingAgain's two autonomous outcomes (progress / stuck, complementary) are jointly-exhaustive guard pairs, per CLAUDE.md's preference over self-loops for autonomous-only modes.

next_step: Run the deterministic pipeline (run_experiment_iteration.py) and read the eight visible phase feedback files.
